en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small village in a wide valley surrounded by steep, rocky mountains. In the right foreground stands a prominent church with a bell tower and dome-like roof, facing a small square and clustered houses. The landscape is filled with fields, orchards, and scattered farm buildings extending to the base of dramatic limestone cliffs and higher peaks in the background. The print has a decorative scalloped border typical of vintage postcards. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.
